status: Correctness amendment before the first new validation score; author finding, no independent review
discovered_in: Kenai annotation-ID validation during whole-clip bootstrap
finding: Official Kenai validation includes annotation ID0. COCO dtMatches uses0 as its unmatched sentinel. A correctly matched ID0 annotation can therefore count as unmatched in scalar AP
v2: Use unique strictly positive annotation IDs inside the evaluator; leave source annotations, image IDs, category IDs, coordinates, detections and operating-point matching unchanged
known_answer: test_zero_annotation_ids.py and test_bootstrap_zero_ids.py reproduce original zero-ID failure and positive-ID correction, including duplicate clips and negatives
historical_outputs: Preserved as originally executed source-ID evaluator v1; any corrected values are separately derived artifacts, never silent overwrites
new_comparisons: Both fresh microbatch4 arms and every subsequent cell use positive-ID evaluator v2
active_training: Fresh published reference training source preserved in training_source_snapshot.zip before evaluator-only change. Training loop, labels, optimizer, seed and sampler remain unchanged; evaluator is not called by detector fitting
Channel: No new inference or target-based repair. Original outputs and exposure remain preserved; historical evaluator limitation must be disclosed
bootstrap_v3: CPU-only run stopped and preserved after discovering sentinel ambiguity; v4 uses gtMatches/dtIds recovery validated against explicit positive-ID duplicate-clip rescoring
